title: Trip plan
audience: For anyone planning a trip who wants the plan, bookings and packing in one place.
description: A trip app: the countdown, a day-by-day plan, bookings with paid ticks and a packing list. Change any of it yourself, or let your AI plan and fill it in.
tagline: Days, bookings and the packing list in one place.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Trip plan". It is an app; its data is "Travel/Trip plan.app/data.json". Read it with fetch before each change, and change it with edit. I'll tell you where I'm going, when, and what I like. Set values.trip (name, place, start, end as yyyy-mm-dd) and write values.days: one { date, title, items } per day with three to five realistic items, with travel time between places. When I paste a booking confirmation, add { id, what, when, ref, paid } to values.bookings. Add what the trip needs to values.packing as { id, text, packed: false }. I can change all of it in the app myself.
